notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes: [p]The demo of Dollhouse of Dead has finally emerged from the shadows. Dare to step inside?[/p][p]Thanks to the screams and whispers of our playtesters, we have reshaped parts of the nightmare:[/p][list][*][p]Certain creatures have been altered, their forms twisted into something more… unsettling[/p][/*][*][p]Balance has been reworked to ensure every encounter keeps you on edge[/p][/*][*][p]Countless cracks in the walls have been sealed—bugs and glitches exorcised to let the horror breathe as intended[/p][/*][/list][p]This is only the beginning. Enter the dollhouse, explore its dark corners, and let us know what terrors you uncover. Your feedback fuels the nightmare[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056165/90e19a266f4da43a3fb99808681d8db75d44e0e9.gif"][/img][/p]
